description: This source file provides functions to encode and decode variable-length integers (varints), commonly used in data serialization. It includes functions 'decode_varint' to parse varints from a buffer, and 'encode_varint' to serialize integers into a varint format.

methods.name: uint64_t decode_varint(const unsigned char ** bufp)
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length integer from a buffer, updating the buffer pointer.
